summary: Frontend E2E test of new Óptica 'Accesorios' feature as optica user (optica / Optica2024$). All 5 requested flows PASS: sidebar nav item (nav-optica-accesorios) appears under Óptica (after expanding the collapsed group) and routes to /optica/accesorios; create accessory (name/brand/desc/cost 10/sale 25.50/stock 7) listed correctly with margin Q15.50 (155%); edit (sale 30, stock 9) persisted; POS shows Armazones(15 cards)/Lentes(21 cards)/Accesorios(2 cards) tabs all working; added accessory x2 to cart, paid Efectivo exact amount, POST /api/optica/sales/v2 -> 200 (ORD-202611-0002, total Q60, status pagado), success dialog shown; stock decremented 9 -> 7 in Accesorios list; delete via confirm dialog removed row.

ui_bugs.issue: After a successful sale, product stock badges are not refreshed (accessory card still shows 9 instead of 7) because procesarVenta only calls fetchVentasHoy(), not fetchProductos(). Pre-existing for all categories, but now applies to accessories too.
No client-side stock cap: user can add more units than stock; only backend rejects with 'Stock insuficiente'. Pre-existing behavior.

issues: Success toast overlaps the 'Nuevo Accesorio' button at top-right (cosmetic, transient).

action_items: Optional: call fetchProductos() after successful sale in OpticaPOS.procesarVenta so stock badges update
Optional: add data-testid to POS category tab buttons (e.g. pos-categoria-accesorios), POS product cards, Accesorios brand/description/cost/stock inputs and delete-confirm button
Optional: debounce search in Accesorios.js (refetches API on every keystroke)
critical_code_review_comments: Accesorios.js: fetchAccesorios depends on searchTerm so every keystroke triggers a GET; filter client-side or debounce.
OpticaPOS.js is ~800 lines - near the 700 line split guideline.
Missing data-testids on POS category tabs, product cards, and some Accesorios form fields (#brand, #description, #cost_price, #stock) and delete confirm button.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted (soft) accessory TEST_Estuche_1793643810. A real sale ORD-202611-0002 (Q60, Consumidor Final, Efectivo) was recorded in preview DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Optica sidebar group is collapsed by default on login -> click text 'Óptica' first before nav-optica-accesorios is visible. POS tabs selectable via get_by_role('button', name='Accesorios', exact=True). Payment: pos-pagar-btn -> pos-metodo-Efectivo -> 'Monto exacto' -> plus button -> 'Confirmar Venta'.
